card.name: Linking words in cardiac trial text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, endings and numbers in cardiovascular drug-label text, such as 'with', 'of', 'the', 'or' before a heart or blood-pressure condition, or digits in section numbers like 2.4.

modes.label: Linking word before condition
modes.description: A short word like with, of, in the or or just before a patient group, finding or condition in trial text.
